# Feature: Avatar V2 Skinned Wearable Runtime

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-19 — #258 -->

## Intent
Verlässliche Skinned-Wearable-Runtime: Family-Fit wählen, gegen aktives Skeleton rebinden, Body Masks ref-counted wiederherstellen.

## Preconditions
- #257 Starter Wardrobe Manifest auf main
- Existing AvatarSkinnedWearableRuntime + skinned-wearable-plan
- skinned-wearable-ready capability when attaching

## Happy Path
- [x] Standard/Compact/Heavy Variant Resolution und Skeleton Rebinding funktionieren mit Starter-Wearables
- [x] Wearables folgen Animationen ohne paralleles Skeleton-Verhalten
- [x] Body Masks bei Stack/Unequip/Model-Swap deterministisch und reversibel (ref-count)
- [x] Inventory bleibt Gameplay-SoT (keine Inventory-State-Änderungen)
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- Mehrere Wearables gleiche Region: remove darf Region nicht vorzeitig einblenden
- Rig/Family mismatch → kein Render + Compatibility-Status
- Rapid Model Swap verwirft stale async loads

## Scope
### In
- BodyFamilyVariantResolver (pure domain)
- Runtime SkeletonUtils clone + rebind to canonical bones
- Body Region Mask apply/restore with ref-counting
- Cache/lifecycle/rapid equip tests
### Out
- New wearable authoring, custom creature, inventory changes, cloth physics

## Security Coverage
- Asset URLs remain allowlisted via existing resolveUrl + normalizeSafeUrl — PASS
- Capability fail-closed (skinned-wearable-ready) — PASS
